text_simplified: How great is the parent's offense against his child when he is an example in neglecting obligations or committing forbidden acts, for children usually grow up influenced by their parent's behavior. The Shaykh recalls Allah's censure of those who command others to good while forgetting themselves, and His detestation of those who say what they do not do. Then the Shaykh explains that whoever takes care of these pillars reaps their fruits in his life through a righteous son who is dutiful to him.
